title: Gallery GET traversal and unguarded HEAD exposed files outside its allowlist
summary: Independent tests reproduced dot-segment GET escaping allowed folders and unrestricted HEAD. Canonical resolved-path checks now run in shared send_head for both verbs; environment files and outside-root paths are denied.
lesson: Authorize the exact canonical path served, and apply the same guard to every method.

title: Incomplete or nonfinite constructed native reports were accepted
summary: The validator previously accepted empty source manifests, unknown checks and NaN viewports. It now requires the full current source set, exact12checks, correct unpublished mode, real finite UI bounds and ordered motion samples.
lesson: Schema integrity supports retained native tool evidence; passing constructed JSON never proves authenticity.

title: Planning resumed after acceptance artifacts changed
summary: Accepted source hashes are now rechecked before status and checkpoint; downstream acceptance is blocked on drift. DRY_RUN no longer advertises execution phases as eligible. Hand-edited authorization flags and phase shapes fail closed.
lesson: Completion is tied to current immutable acceptance artifacts, not only a saved status string.

title: Repeated media intake missed deleted bytes; full clip sampling asked for EOF
summary: Exact repeated imports repair missing archived media and preserve reviewed metadata; tampering fails closed. Half-open contact-sheet sampling now decodes a full-duration1second real video without requesting an EOF frame.
lesson: Recheck retained bytes and record actual sampling times.

title: Startup viewport and report lifetime made early native observations invalid
summary: The fixture waits for stable real viewport/layout and stores JSON in PlayerScripts so initial spawn does not clear it. All12named native checks passed after source sync/readback.
lesson: Wait for stable native state, retain source readback and distinguish programmatic actions from native input.

title: Blender project MCP activation is blocked by normal host trust state
summary: TOML and direct subprocess MCP work; installed Codex config/read explicitly disabled this project layer because the workspace is untrusted. Automatic approval review rejected a temporary process trust override. No global trust or safeguards were changed.
lesson: Installed/configured/exercised direct tooling is distinct from host discovery. Use supported owner trust controls and reload; preserve safeguards.

title: Large native source readback was truncated
summary: One native JSON readback stopped at100013characters and could not parse. Bounded source chunks now return complete JSON and21 current Creator sources match disk.
lesson: Preserve actual source contents and split results below the installed output cap.

title: Effect counts passed while the capture missed the cues
summary: The default camera followed a falling avatar away from fixed diagnostic effects. The fixture now owns/restores its camera; the repaired capture shows three cues and all9checks pass.
lesson: Inspect actual pixels separately from instantiated-object counts.

title: Native observation status text overflowed
summary: A real trace recorded8text-overflow rows. Wrapping and a96pixel label fixed the fixture; repeated native trace validation records0overflow. Unrelated source drift was fixed by binding only the exact consumed sources.
lesson: Treat native trace findings as repair evidence and keep immutable readback receipts.

title: Missing native receipts could leave a passing local gate
summary: Required native receipts are now mandatory; malformed files become named failures, complete authored sources are checked before/after, and12regressions pass.
lesson: Always write a fresh result and fail closed on absent evidence.

title: Two Studio clients joined but sent no input before watchdog
summary: Source-rebound first attempt joined two clients yet received zero protocol input by20seconds. The failed tool receipt is retained; unchanged-source retries passed6aggregate+22participant checks. Cause of the initial startup delay remains unverified.
limitations: Warm retries do not certify cold-start reliability or performance.
No deadline was extended to turn this failure into a pass.
